role: Destructive memory actions of the assistant namespace (clear, remove, restore) and DestructiveActionContext, the confirmation gate they share with assistant.contacts.remove, plus gateUnlessUserStated, the same gate for the writes whose content the model supplies (memory add, contact add, location.set_address, route rename) when that content is not in the user's own latest message.
types: AssistantMemoryNamespace.DestructiveActionContext: struct (@MainActor) — confirmations store + transcript + now; .live reads AppDependencies

units.does: Builds the live context: the current AssistantViewModel's actionConfirmations (the conversation's pending requests) and its transcript, now = Date().

nil when every value is stated in the context's latest user message (AssistantMemoryNamespace.isStated: whole words, case/punctuation-insensitive), so the write goes ahead without asking; otherwise gate(action:target:question:): nil once the user's latest message confirms this exact request, else confirmationRequired(question) (request recorded) or missing(invalidParameter) when there is no user message.

branches.cond: every value is stated in the latest user message
branches.effect: return nil (no confirmation needed); else return gate(...)

units.does: Runs AssistantActionConfirmations.evaluate on the context transcript: nil when confirmed (the caller proceeds), confirmationRequired(question) when the request was recorded, .missing(invalidParameter) when there is no user message.
Record {status:"confirmation_required", executed:false, ask_user:<app-written question>, next_step:<ask, end the reply, call again with the same arguments only on a plain yes>}.

When store.hasAnythingToForget is false (no facts and no set-aside copy) returns {cleared:false,count_before:0,note} without asking. Otherwise gates on "assistant.memory.clear"/"all" with the question "Delete all N saved memory facts?" (or, with no facts but a set-aside copy, "Delete the unreadable copy of your saved memory?"); once confirmed calls store.clearKeepingBackup(): nil returns {cleared:false,count_before:N,note} saying the facts are all still stored; a count returns {cleared:true,count_before,undo}.

branches.effect: question names the N facts; else asks about the unreadable copy

branches.cond: gate returned a result (not yet confirmed)

branches.effect: returns cleared:false with a try-again note; else cleared:true with the erased count

units.does: Finds the fact by id (missing notRecorded when absent), gates on "assistant.memory.remove"/id with the question naming the fact text; once confirmed calls store.remove(id): false returns {removed:false,id,note} saying the fact is still stored; true returns {removed:true,id,text}.

branches.cond: gate returned a result (not yet confirmed)

branches.effect: returns removed:false with a try-again note; else removed:true

units.does: Missing notRecorded when store.clearedBackup is empty; otherwise store.restoreCleared() and returns {restored,count}.
